workflow: An owned isolated AutoCAD 24.3 process creates two ISO A4 portrait layouts in deliberate SECTION 10 then PLAN 20 tab order, requests the non-alphabetic PLAN 20 then SECTION 10 order through SetLayoutsToPlot, observes native PDF creation order, requests PLAN 20 alone, saves DWG and reopens it.
result: AutoCAD created PLAN 20 then SECTION 10 PDFs in the requested non-alphabetic order and one excluded-set PLAN PDF. pypdf, pdfplumber and Poppler proved the titles, A4 pages and vector-only output; native DWG reopen preserved both layouts. The owned process terminated and the pre-existing process set was restored.
